summary: The University of Cambridge EPSRC Centre for Doctoral Training in Sensor Technologies and Applications offers a combined MRes and PhD starting in October 2027. A single application covers both, and eligible applicants are considered automatically for funded places. The funding deadline for all applicants, including international, is 6 January 2027; first-round interviews run from late January to February 2027.
